meta.title: Removing a vendor who already participated is refused

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The buyer removes the invited vendor from the live round for the invited QA vendor.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You cannot remove a vendor who has already participated.”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: Removing a vendor who already participated is refused

expected.message: You cannot remove a vendor who has already participated.
